resources.string: Create a household or join someone you know.
Selecting a household does not move your local drafts.
Remove this member? They will lose access when their device next connects. Offline devices may still show previously downloaded tasks.
Make this member the owner? You will remain a member but can no longer manage invitations or membership.
This link works for one person and expires in 24 hours. If you lose it, cancel the invitation and create a new one.
Waiting for the invitation to be opened
Ask the person you invited for their code. Approve only if it matches.
Tell this code to the person who invited you. Refresh after they approve.
Code from the person you invited
Delete this household? Everyone loses access immediately. Unsynced work on other devices may be lost. Export anything you need before continuing. The household has a 30-day recovery window.
This household was deleted. Access is closed. The recovery window is 30 days.
Leave this household? You will lose access to shared tasks. Save any unsent text you need before continuing.
That invitation link is not valid. Ask for a new link.
This invitation is no longer available for this account. Ask the owner for a new one.
The codes do not match. Check with the person you invited.
Too many attempts. Try again in an hour.
A household can have up to ten members.
Cancel an unused invitation before creating another.
You no longer have access to this household. Your local drafts are still safe.
Someone changed the household. Refresh and try again.
Return to Account and refresh your sign-in before continuing.
Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
This household is full. You can still cancel invitations, remove members or delete the household.
